reason: The PR is not just incidental bindinfo plumbing: it directly changes core paths in executor (`pkg/executor/select.go`), planner plan-cache logic (`pkg/planner/core/plan_cache_utils.go`), and statement context state (`pkg/sessionctx/stmtctx/stmtctx.go`). Saving bindinfo in `stmtctx` can affect binding lookup timing, plan selection/cache behavior, and per-statement runtime state, so it is clearly centered on planner/executor/sessionctx concerns.
